facts.text: The turtlebot3_node package is a ROS 2 ament_cmake package that depends on rclcpp.
The bringup launch selects param/humble/<model>.yaml on Humble and param/<model>.yaml otherwise.
The Humble Burger parameter file disables stamped cmd_vel.
The Humble Waffle parameter file disables stamped cmd_vel.
The Humble Waffle Pi parameter file disables stamped cmd_vel.
The Burger bringup parameter file sets enable_stamped_cmd_vel to true.
The Waffle bringup parameter file sets enable_stamped_cmd_vel to true.
The Waffle Pi bringup parameter file sets enable_stamped_cmd_vel to true.
TwistSubscriber declares enable_stamped_cmd_vel false when the parameter is absent, then reads it and subscribes geometry_msgs::msg::TwistStamped when true or geometry_msgs::msg::Twist otherwise.
TurtleBot3::cmd_vel_callback constructs TwistSubscriber with the relative topic name "cmd_vel".

The TwistStamped callback uses only twist.linear.x and twist.angular.z, multiplies each by 100, casts to int32, writes the six-register velocity block to the OpenCR, and returns void after a debug log; it publishes no motion acknowledgement or stop timer.
TurtleBot3::add_devices registers the relative "motor_power" service.
MotorPower's constructor creates a std_srvs::srv::SetBool service on the supplied server name.

MotorPower::command writes request.data to the motor_torque_enable control-table address and returns the Dynamixel SDK write's success/message; it does not write a velocity setpoint or wait for the wheels to stop.
TurtleBot3::add_sensors constructs the relative "battery_state" publisher.
The battery_state publisher is sensor_msgs::msg::BatteryState.

BatteryState::publish sets design_capacity 1.8, voltage as 0.01 times the battery_voltage register, percentage as 0.01 times the battery_percentage register, and present false when voltage is at most 7.0.
TurtleBot3::add_sensors constructs the relative "sensor_state" publisher.
The sensor_state publisher is turtlebot3_msgs::msg::SensorState.
SensorState::publish reads the motor_torque_enable register into msg->torque.
TurtleBot3::add_sensors constructs the relative "joint_states" publisher.
The joint_states publisher is sensor_msgs::msg::JointState.
JointState::publish pushes two wheel velocities converted by RPM_TO_MS.
The diff_drive_controller node publishes nav_msgs::msg::Odometry on the relative name "odom".
The node registers the relative "reset" service.
Reset::command writes an IMU recalibration, sleeps five seconds, sets success=true, and then only logs the asynchronous reset_odometry reply.
The teleoperation script caps Burger at 0.22 m/s and 2.84 rad/s and Waffle/Waffle Pi at 0.26 m/s and 1.82 rad/s; these are teleoperation caps, not measured hardware limits.

safe_state.description: The acknowledged /motor_power std_srvs/SetBool service with data=false disables the OpenCR motor-torque enable register; this is a torque-disable acknowledgement only, not a brake, not a measured zero velocity and not a hardware emergency stop.
